gates.name: MODEL SURFACE COMPLETE
gates.question: Does every shipped model appear on the surface and in the final accounting?
gates.would_fail_if: a model had been dropped because no data was found for it

gates.name: SOURCE PROVENANCE
gates.question: Does every evidence row trace to a source with a recorded origin and hash, and does every hash still resolve?
gates.would_fail_if: a measurement had entered the suite without an entry in EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE.json, or a file had changed since it was hashed

gates.name: APPLICABILITY
gates.question: Was anything screened out of scope counted as model validation?
gates.would_fail_if: a half-cell potential, an example table or a simulator output had been counted as evidence for a shipped model

gates.name: CALIBRATION INDEPENDENCE
gates.question: Did any point set a parameter and then score it, and do the counts that ran match the counts that were fixed?
gates.would_fail_if: a held-out point had been used as calibration, or a count had drifted from the plan without a finding naming it

declared_discrepancies.MV-C: MVF-7 - VALIDATION_SPLIT.json counts the 0 degC entry twice

gates.name: METRIC VALIDITY
gates.question: Was every metric and tolerance fixed before the comparison ran, and justified by something other than what the Core achieves?
gates.would_fail_if: a threshold had been moved after seeing a result

evidence.how_those_were_handled: the rule and its result stand unedited; the correction is a labelled secondary analysis and a finding

gates.name: UNCERTAINTY HONESTY
gates.question: Is measurement uncertainty represented where it is known, and is it never silently zero?
gates.would_fail_if: any comparison had been scored against an uncertainty of zero, or a relaxed value had been read off the wrong end of its trace

budget_terms: state of charge through the local dOCV/dSOC
residual relaxation measured from the data
quantities_with_no_published_uncertainty: the S-DCHG discharge current, recorded as UNCERTAINTY_NOT_REPORTED and worse - the value itself is absent

gates.name: EMPIRICAL AGREEMENT
gates.question: Is there an unresolved material mismatch inside the empirically covered subset?
gates.would_fail_if: a measured mismatch inside a model's own declared regime had been left standing

detail.configuration: affine chord between two declared endpoints
detail.statement: Against measured relaxed open-circuit voltage on a LiFePO4 cell, the affine chord misses every held-out state of charge. Mean absolute error 175 mV, worst 293 mV, against a measurement uncertainty of a few millivolts. The worst residual is 217 times its own expanded uncertainty.

evidence.why_this_gate_fails: MVF-1 stands. The affine-chord configuration misses measured open-circuit voltage by up to 293 mV inside a regime none of the model's validity conditions excludes, replicated on a second cell and corroborated by a second experiment on ten more. The gate is reported FAIL rather than argued away, and MVF-2 records what would resolve it.

gates.name: RESIDUAL SHAPE
gates.question: Is any systematic bias hidden behind a summary number?
gates.would_fail_if: a case had shown systematic structure that no finding accounted for

each_one_explained.MV-A: the finding itself; the chord's error is structural and MVF-1 says so
each_one_explained.MV-A-replicate: the same finding on a second cell
each_one_explained.MV-C: expected and required: the linear law drops exactly -B t^2, so the residual MUST be quadratic. Its fitted curvature is 5.77647e-05 against the |B| R0 = 5.775e-05 the algebra predicts
each_one_explained.MV-D: departures from a straight line are magnitudes and cannot change sign; the drift with duration is reported

gates.name: AUDITOR FALSIFICATION
gates.question: Does the machinery notice when a failure is planted in it?
gates.would_fail_if: any planted failure had passed unnoticed

plants.plant: +5 percent systematic bias on every Core open-circuit voltage
resistance-temperature slope 2 percent too steep, exact at the reference point
every Core open-circuit voltage multiplied by 1000
the relaxed open-circuit voltage read at 1 h instead of 24 h
a calibration point duplicated into the held-out set
measurement uncertainty set to zero on a passing case
a row screened OUT_OF_SCOPE relabelled as validation
one failing held-out point relabelled as calibration

control.note: The control is NOT expected to be clean. MV-A fails its preregistered tolerance at every held-out point and MV-C fails at six of 371, both for reasons adjudicated in the findings, and the split check reports the one-row discrepancy recorded as MVA-1. What the control establishes is the BASELINE each plant is measured against, so a plant only counts if it makes things worse.

gates.name: PREVIOUS ASSURANCE PRESERVED
gates.question: Did this round change anything the earlier rounds certified?
gates.would_fail_if: a production file had been edited, which would have required every earlier assurance layer to be re-run

evidence.expected_digest_is: the scientific tree as merged into the sprint chain, not a certificate. Core V1's 47-module digest was the previous value and stopped describing this lineage at 3d642dcef5db

gates.name: FROZEN EVIDENCE PRESERVED
gates.question: Are the earlier rounds' artifacts, Blind V2's frozen set included, untouched?
gates.would_fail_if: any earlier round's artifact had been rewritten

note_on_a_failing_gate: MV-7 is expected to fail and failing it is the round's result. A gate that passed by reclassifying a measured mismatch as out of scope would be worth nothing.
